rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying a quantity is approximately a particular amount.

example.english: This restaurant has approximately sixty seats.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳大概有六十個位。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 daai6 koi3 jau5 luk6 sap6 go3 wai2

rows.note: Use this after a number or quantity, as in 六十左右, to mean “around sixty.”

example.english: Our company has approximately one hundred employees.
example.traditional: 我哋公司有一百人左右。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 baak3 jan4 zo2 jau6

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative when the amount is roughly the stated figure rather than exact.

example.english: The package weighs approximately two pounds.
example.jyutping: go3 baau1 gwo2 caa1 m4 do1 jau5 loeng5 bong6
